# HLD

> Real-time collaborative whiteboard for teams. Draw shapes, add sticky notes, and design system architectures together on an infinite canvas — powered by Liveblocks, Convex, and Clerk.

HLD is a web-based collaborative diagramming and whiteboarding tool. It enables multiple users to work simultaneously on a shared infinite canvas with real-time synchronisation. It is free to use and supports user authentication via Clerk.

## Features

- Real-time collaboration with live cursors and presence indicators
- Infinite canvas with pan and zoom
- Drawing tools: shapes (rectangle, ellipse, triangle, diamond, path), freehand pen
- Sticky notes with customisable text and colours
- System architecture diagram templates (AWS, serverless, software architecture)
- Board management: create, rename, favourite, and delete boards
- Organisation and team management
- Mobile responsive
- Free and open source

## Tech Stack

- **Frontend**: Next.js 14, React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Shadcn UI
- **Real-time**: Liveblocks (live cursors, canvas sync)
- **Database / Backend**: Convex (real-time database and server functions)
- **Authentication**: Clerk
